newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian bus driver charged over death crash.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian bus driver charged over death crash.

text.p: The driver of a bus which rammed into a parked truck on a Malaysian highway earlier this month killing 13 Singaporean tourists was charged in a Malaysian court on Tuesday with negligence.

Rosni Faat, 31, of the Muar district in the south Malaysian state of Johore, faces a maximum sentence of a 10,000 ringgit ($3,970) fine and five years' jail if convicted, the national Bernama news agency said.

The bus was on its way to Malaysia's popular hilltop casino resort, Genting Highlands, on December 3 when it collided with the truck and burst into flames, killing the 13 tourists and injuring 12 other passengers.
Rosni was allowed bail of 3,000 ringgit, but could not raise the money and was remanded in custody, Bernama said. ($1=2.52 ringgit)
